system.description: A Focus for a heavily armored defender who is difficult to move or hurt.

abilities.name: Battle Competence
abilities.description: Use all weapons and armor freely, and use an action to learn the levels of up to three nearby creatures.

abilities.name: Imperturbable
abilities.description: You cannot be forced to flee, and nearby allies gain an eased defense against effects that would make them flee.

abilities.name: Nothing but Defend
abilities.description: If you do nothing but defend on your turn, gain an asset to all defense tasks for one round.

abilities.name: Resist the Elements
abilities.description: Choose a harmful energy type and reduce wounds from it by one severity step.

abilities.name: Shield Master
abilities.description: Your shield can take one additional moderate wound before it is destroyed.

abilities.name: Defend and Respond
abilities.description: After blocking or dodging a melee attack, immediately make a melee attack against the attacker once per turn.

abilities.name: Throw Shield
abilities.description: Throw your shield as a short-range light weapon; it returns to you after a successful difficulty 2 Speed task.

abilities.name: Unmovable
abilities.description: You cannot be knocked down, pushed back, or moved against your will while upright and able to act.

abilities.name: Hard-Won Resilience
abilities.description: You can take one additional moderate wound before you are incapacitated.

abilities.name: Inspiring Defense
abilities.description: After an especially powerful attack fails against your defense, regain 4 Might, with later uses restoring one fewer point until a ten-hour recovery.

abilities.name: Tower of Will
abilities.description: Gain an asset to Intellect defense tasks and add 3 points to your Intellect Pool.

abilities.name: Weave an Iron Wall
abilities.description: Create a maintained weapon barrier across an immediate area that deals 10 damage to creatures crossing it.

abilities.name: Attenuate Threat
abilities.description: When attacking as a Last action, ignore one wound taken before the beginning of your next turn.

abilities.name: Bouncing Shield
abilities.description: Throw your shield at a foe; it rebounds to attack two additional targets before returning or landing nearby.

abilities.name: Lethal Capability
abilities.description: Choose a specific attack type; attacks of that type inflict 5 additional damage. You can choose this ability again for a different attack.
